_comment: Single source of truth for every figure the papers assert. tests/test_manifest.py fails when a paper states a figure that disagrees with this file. Adapted from the release-manifest practice of OpenEtruscan (github.com/Eddy1919/openEtruscan).

linear_a.note: 1720 in earlier drafts; 1719 is the count after excluding the empty record

etruscan.source: OpenEtruscan (Zenodo), Larth Dataset + CIE Vol. I

withdrawn.claim: the ascendency-to-capacity ratio falls inside Ulanowicz's window of vitality
withdrawn.why: a null preserving row and column sums reproduces the observed value to three decimals
withdrawn.where_stated: method paper, section on withdrawn results

withdrawn.claim: the Minoan lexicon is compositional above chance
withdrawn.why: a null preserving syllable transitions puts the observed value inside the null (p = 0.60)
withdrawn.where_stated: method paper, section on withdrawn results

withdrawn.claim: no Linear A sign-group ends in -so, a phonotactic feature
withdrawn.why: the syllable so never occurs in any position; the absence is a gap in the transliterated syllabary
withdrawn.where_stated: method paper, replaced by the final-syllable distribution

withdrawn.claim: the *305 dossier is weighed, on the evidence of the double mina
withdrawn.why: the double mina measures cyperus, figs, grain and personal names on six documents, and never *305

withdrawn.claim: the absence of a MUL sign shows Minoan administration made no sex distinction
withdrawn.why: an inference from an absence without checking the instrument could see it; Uchitel proposes *306 for that function

prior_art._comment: results of ours that have a published precedent, with the holder. Any paper stating these as new fails review.
prior_art.fraction_values: Montecchi 2009 and Corazza et al. 2021, in disagreement

star303_identification.field_position_2025: grain or cyperus, undecided (Salgarella and Petrakis eds. 2025)
star303_identification.our_contribution: quantitative profile: median 0.62, 61% of records fractional, maximum 23, against grain's 15.62, 13% and 976

closed_avenues.what: comparison of the receipt form with the Ugarit and Alalakh archives from their texts
closed_avenues.why: no digitised corpora of those archives exist in consultable form
closed_avenues.source: J. Lauinger (Johns Hopkins), personal communication, 9 September 2026
closed_avenues.consequence: the comparison rests on published descriptions; declared as a limitation in the receipt paper

closed_avenues.what: testing whether cyperus appears in Minoan process vessels
closed_avenues.why: the Mochlos aromatics workshop analysis (Koh 2006/2008) is not obtainable; the Penn repository does not hold the dissertation
closed_avenues.consequence: the stypsis prediction remains untested; stated as such in the aromatics paper

closed_avenues.what: the Etruscan Texts Project as a corpus source
closed_avenues.why: the ETP site is dead and it is in any case a supplement of ~300 post-1990 texts
closed_avenues.consequence: replaced by the OpenEtruscan corpus (5,941 distinct texts), which is better for our purpose
